answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the ferrous binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 7 separate vaults calls for a separate funded ivory account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The shale explorer publishes the whole merge tree. A farm of 63 pays that 29 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
